candidate_sentence_map.S1: AB KN Energies reported stronger financial performance for the three months ended 31 March 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Group revenue increased to EUR 29.823 million from EUR 25.326 million in the same period of 2025, an increase of approximately 18%.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Revenue growth was mainly driven by LNG terminal regasification services, which rose to EUR 19.162 million from EUR 14.593 million, liquid energy product transshipment services, which increased to EUR 7.596 million from EUR 6.615 million, and consulting services, which increased to EUR 2.749 million from EUR 1.932 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: These increases more than offset lower revenue from other LNG terminal-related sales and transshipment activities.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Revenue from LNG services included in the security supplement remained negative at EUR 905 thousand, reflecting the proportionally recognized repayment of excess returns from regulated activities in 2022–2023.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Cost of sales increased 9% to EUR 16.916 million, while distribution and administrative expenses rose 10% to EUR 3.316 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Higher costs included wages, environmental pollution taxes and emissions allowances, repairs and maintenance, and electricity.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Despite the cost increases, gross profit improved 32% to EUR 12.907 million, and operating profit rose 35% to EUR 9.608 million from EUR 7.141 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: Group EBITDA increased to EUR 16.153 million from EUR 13.591 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Segmentally, LNG terminal activities generated EUR 5.896 million of profit before tax compared with EUR 2.174 million a year earlier, while LNG commercial activities increased to EUR 1.298 million from EUR 903 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Liquid energy terminals declined to EUR 1.630 million from EUR 2.287 million, reflecting lower EBITDA despite slightly lower revenue.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Net finance costs improved substantially to EUR 784 thousand from EUR 1.777 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Finance income increased to EUR 1.076 million, including a EUR 458 thousand net gain on derivatives, while finance costs fell to EUR 1.860 million from EUR 2.345 million, primarily because interest expenses on borrowings declined.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Consequently, profit before tax increased 64% to EUR 8.824 million, and profit for the period rose 64% to EUR 7.247 million from EUR 4.426 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Earnings per share increased to EUR 0.02 from EUR 0.01.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: Operating cash flow more than doubled to EUR 27.917 million from EUR 13.758 million, supported particularly by a EUR 7.010 million decrease in receivables compared with an increase in the prior-year period.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Investing cash outflows increased to EUR 10.771 million, including EUR 4.906 million of capital expenditure, while financing outflows rose to EUR 11.521 million due mainly to higher loan repayments and interest paid.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 17.986 million from EUR 12.361 million at year-end.
candidate_sentence_map.S19: Total assets were broadly stable at EUR 556.798 million, while equity increased to EUR 179.866 million, primarily through current-period profit.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, K6, and K9 are all PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K7 (total borrowings and lease liabilities) and K8 (change in Board governance structure) are MISSING. The summary captures most HIGH importance items but omits two MEDIUM/ HIGH items, resulting in a Generally yes rating.
